name: Incendiary Grenade
notes: Deals fire damage and puts fire on the ground in that area for some time. Looks like Burning Ground (Wizard Meteor orb) in the whole frag radius area.
summary: Turns the Frag Grenade into an Incendiary Grenade that deals fire damage and blinds enemies while they burn. Has fire penetration instead of armor penetration. Deals 10% of frag's damage every 0.5s with a 10 second cooldown.
